Maya (platform): Heads-up — I'm planning a sweeper job next week to prune deprecated runtime flags across services. Thinking dry-run -> gated commit. Planned window: Mon 02:00 PT. Quick sync?
Jon (runtime): ++ what's the exact scope? all flags or only flagged-for-removal ones? :eyes:
Maya (platform): only flags tagged `deprecated:true` and the console TTL list. We'll skip any flag with `owner=null` or `safety:critical`.
Priya (infra): pls ensure we don't touch infra toggles (load-balancer, rollout-keys). Can we get a preflight that lists per-service diffs?
Sam (ops): dry-run + per-service opt-in is a must. Also need an approval step for any service with >3 flags removed.
Maya (platform): Agreed. Proposal: 3-step flow — 1) dry-run (no writes, produce diff) 2) staged commit (sampled cohorts 5%,25%,100%) 3) final sweep. Each step emits telemetry and audit entries.
Jon (runtime): telemetry events should be `config.sweeper.preview`, `config.sweeper.commit`, `config.sweeper.pruned` with counts + owner id. Include per-service error_rate delta pre/post.
Priya (infra): We should gate by pre/post SLO regression for 1h after each cohort bump. If error_rate delta > 1% or latency +p95 > 50ms, auto-pause.
Sam (ops): How do we express the API? I want both UI and `redwoodctl` support. Suggested API: `POST /v1/internal/configs/sweep` {"dry_run":true, "services":[], "owners_override":false, "cohort_pct":5} and a `GET /v1/internal/configs/sweep/{id}/preview`
Maya (platform): API shape looks fine. Let's not expose it publicly; internal-only with RBAC. Console will call preview endpoint and show diffs and owner links.
Jon (runtime): Implementation note — runtime needs a `sweepable()` predicate that consults `owner`, `safety`, `last_used_ts`. Prefer we only remove if `last_used_ts > 90d` and `deprecated:true`.
Priya (infra): Edge-case: flags used only in one region/zone. We should skip flags with region-specific usages unless owner approves.
Sam (ops): For rollback: the job should store a snapshot of prior config -> `sweeper_snapshot_{id}.json` and allow `POST /v1/internal/configs/sweep/{id}/rollback`.
Maya (platform): Console UX: preview diffs, per-flag owner badge, bulk-approve checkbox, and a big red EMERGENCY PAUSE button that flips a `sweeper.pause` flag. Also provide `dry-run` permalink for audits.
Jon (runtime): Also add a safety TTL: any auto-deleted flag will be kept in snapshot for 30 days before permanent remove. That makes rollback cheap.
Priya (infra): Ownership: if owner metadata missing, we should send a slack DM to `@ownerless-flags` channel and skip by default. Ops can override with `owners_override=true` but require 2 approvers.
Sam (ops): Shadowing idea: internally apply the removals to a runtime *shadow* store and run a 1-hour canary traffic pass. If no regressions, continue. Might be heavier but safer.
Maya (platform): MVP = dry-run + staged commit + snapshots + console approvals + telemetry + emergency pause. Shadowing can be follow-up.
Jon (runtime): Dev question — do we reuse existing ownership index API? `/v1/flags/{name}/owners` exists but it's slow. Maybe implement a bulk-owner-index lookup for the sweeper.
Priya (infra): Agree — add a bulk endpoint to avoid N calls. Also ensure rate-limit headers for safety.
Maya (platform): Ops & infra: can you list required metrics to gate on (error_rate, p95, token-failure-count) by EOD? I'll draft the API and console mock tomorrow and post a short RFC.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: Scheduled job queued for dry-run Monday 02:00 PT — sweep-id=sw-20240401-01
Sam (ops): Nice. I'll add a runbook section for emergency pause and rollback.
Priya (infra): +1, and I'll prototype the bulk-owner endpoint.
Jon (runtime): I'll add the `sweepable()` predicates and snapshot plumbing.
Maya (platform): Thanks — sync on standup tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
